required_external_checks: resolve assembly/provider receipt from official provider, not input boolean
tenant binding/membership epoch/RG1 fence and actual read scope
actual recording generation/D4 binding and D1,D2/slot/current PlayRow version
rule/vocabulary/T1 artifact/model/schema hashes match provider and expected_versions
closed S active latest applied source; replacement/tombstone/retirement/control records are not event contributions
no duplicate effective source identity or duplicate D5 retry contribution
PA identity/ordinal/start/end and actual/credited participants match source provenance
out_effect quantities/runner validity/RBI branch/steal observation receipts match accepted T1 values
provisional before_apply isolated from committed relation and never published as confirmed
T6 ended receipt/public fact pointer/latest effective source and same model/tenant/player/JST-year/raw-key filters

x-semantic_constraints.rule: confirmed_game requires official assembly receipt and applied source for contribution; non-effective/audit lifecycle is excluded, not inferred from flags
effective play source requires non-null generation/d1/d2/play_row/version; audit/control D1-null uses target lineage in provider, never fabricated D1
stat_flags has exactly 23 booleans, copied from verified T1; never caller observations and never re-derived by primitive
effective pitch iff stat_flags.投球数=true; non_pitch/control cannot add pitch_count; mismatch rejected
PA metrics use one canonical completed PA row, linked by pa_id/ordinal/credited batter; incomplete PA gives no completed PA metrics, even if pitches exist
outs use effective_count/targets receipt; after.outs-before.outs is not quantity across reset. K independent of outs
runs/RBI are per verified scoring participant with valid_run/rbi_credited, never int(boolean). rbi requires valid_run and credited batter/branch receipt
hit_kind/result ID mapping and total bases (1/2/3/4) are declared once; flags and result/PA inconsistency rejected, no ordinal encoding
complete out_effect/runs/steals cannot be null; unavailable must be null and only dependent metrics become source_unavailable, never zero
on half-inning/third out reset preserve actual before/after and credited outs; active prior generations remain included in S
walk inheritance uses verified A-2 responsible pitcher; do not use that for BF; runs use runner responsibility not current pitcher
T6 DB sums canonical T5 sufficient statistics; no per-game application-side sum/rate average; closed ended receipt required, reopened/superseded excluded
source type rejection fails closed; source-unavailable required primitive does not become fabricated false/0/empty observations
T6 source fact uniqueness uses tenant/game/player/public fact version and effective pointer, not event IDs; aggregate credits bind source-set digest, never fabricate source_event_id
out targets unique and quantity matches accepted effective_count; roster/runner identities and actual before/after come from official provider, not fabricated fixture defaults
PA display/counts_as_ab/hit/reached/RBI are generated once as FR-022 PA row; game counts reference that row; do not duplicate PA-event counting expressions
source quantity/canonical status mismatch is rejected; schema-null observation declared unavailable propagates only dependent count state; never substitutes zero
D02,D03,D04,D05 remain pending; 0-pitch entry/unfinished PA/reentry and responsibility can be carried without inventing appearances/BF/OPS/category values

device_provisional has explicit namespace, not_committed ledger/null physical row/unassigned D1/D2; source UUID is device operation identity only. Verify device/base checkpoint authority separately. confirmed_game rejects that source, no accepted-event fabrication

PA pitcher_changes carries actual before-change count and participant source receipts; inherited walk responsibility comes from verified A-2 source, not BF/appearance inference. Missing change history is unavailable attribution, never assumed current pitcher

assembly_computed_metric_keys/provider receipt and each T5 fact computed_metric_keys are authoritative completeness. Fact value null iff not computed; empty selected set yields genuine0 only for receipt-certified computed keys; missing source/partial fact never becomes0

A-1 OUT3 invalid home arrival is outside RBI-01..09 input domain: valid_run=false => rbi_branch=null, rbi_credited=false, rbi_batter_id=null. Do not adjudicate as RBI-09. valid_run=true keeps mandatory one of nine branches; primitive consumes provider result, never re-adjudicates.
